tr: “Not all of the volunteers stayed.” — Bazı gönüllülerin ayrıldığını söyler mi?
de: “Not all of the volunteers stayed.” — Sagt der Satz, dass einige Freiwillige gegangen sind?

tr: „It's time we asked the owner.“ — Bu cümle geçmişte olmuş bir şeyi mi anlatıyor?
de: „It's time we asked the owner.“ — Erzählt dieser Satz etwas, das in der Vergangenheit geschehen ist?

tr: “I was wondering if you could help.” — Bu cümle geçmişteki bir düşünceyi anlatır.
de: “I was wondering if you could help.” — Dieser Satz beschreibt einen Gedanken aus der Vergangenheit.

tr: “Only residents can park here” ile “Residents can park only here” aynı anlamdadır.
de: “Only residents can park here” und “Residents can park only here” bedeuten dasselbe.

tr: “The school is to stop grading homework.” — Bu cümle resmî bir kararı bildirir mi?
de: “The school is to stop grading homework.” — Meldet dieser Satz eine amtliche Entscheidung?

tr: „When we arrived, the ferry left.“ — Bu cümle vapurun biz gelmeden gittiğini söyler mi?
de: „When we arrived, the ferry left.“ — Sagt dieser Satz, dass die Fähre abgefahren war, bevor wir kamen?

tr: „The results will be sent by someone next week.“ — „by someone“ cümleye bilgi katıyor mu?
de: „The results will be sent by someone next week.“ — Fügt „by someone“ dem Satz eine Information hinzu?

tr: “I'd have thought the second act was the problem.” — Konuşan görüşünü yumuşatarak söylüyor.
de: “I'd have thought the second act was the problem.” — Die sprechende Person sagt ihre Meinung abgeschwächt.

tr: “A limit that just moves the crowd solves nothing.” — Burada “just” “yalnızca” anlamındadır.
de: “A limit that just moves the crowd solves nothing.” — Hier bedeutet “just” so viel wie “nur”.

tr: “In the event that the coordinator leaves, a volunteer will take over.” — Bu cümle doğru mu?
de: “In the event that the coordinator leaves, a volunteer will take over.” — Stimmt dieser Satz?

tr: „We had been walking for three hours when it started to rain.“ — Yağmur başladığında yürüyüş sürüyor muydu?
de: „We had been walking for three hours when it started to rain.“ — War die Wanderung noch im Gang, als der Regen einsetzte?

tr: “Such was the demand that the list closed.” ile “The demand was so great that the list closed.” aynı anlamdadır.
de: “Such was the demand that the list closed.” und “The demand was so great that the list closed.” bedeuten dasselbe.
